overview: This Senate resolution allows the atrium of the Hart Senate Office Building, one of the main buildings where senators have their offices, to be used on February 25, 2026, from 4 to 6 p.m. for a "Bipawtisan Doggi Gras Pawrade," a Mardi Gras-themed dog parade. Its preamble notes how many American households have dogs and says dogs help bring people with different backgrounds and beliefs together. The Senate approved it on February 12, 2026.
for: Supporters say the event is a lighthearted way to bring people together across party lines.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and only books a space for an event, without changing any law or spending.
